v0.7: New release with various bug fixes and increased verification level.

Bug fixes:
* Remove write support on cycle counter register. CSR registers used to access it are marked as read only.
* Fix issue with missed interrupts when reading/setting/clearing CSR_MIP.
* Tweak LSU status tracking to simplify verification benches.
description:
v0.7: New release with various bug fixes and increased verification level.

Bug fixes:
* Remove write support on cycle counter register. CSR registers used to access it are marked as read only.
* Fix issue with missed interrupts when reading/setting/clearing CSR_MIP.
* Tweak LSU status tracking to simplify verification benches.
